answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must bind cryptographic attestation chains via zero-knowledge proofs to a staking tier where minting identities scales cost superlinearly ($O(2^n)$). When a malicious swarm surges like a comet across the network, exponential capital exhaustion pushes budget limits off a ledge, barring attackers from reaching the zenith of governance consensus without forfeiting colossal liquidity.
